title: Continuity — launch film
logline: For design engineers who have seen too much sloppy AI video: Continuity gives agents a studio process and eyes, so what they make is good enough to ship. Open source.

scenes.intent: Name the problem in one breath: agents can write motion, but they can't see it.

beats.note: 'Agents can write motion.' rises word by word
'They just can't see it.' rises word by word
'see' goes out of focus: the problem made visible

elements.note: Headline size h1 (120px), left-aligned on the safe left edge, fg. The two lines sit as one block, vertically centered.
Headline h1 directly under l1. Render from text.l2 split around the word 'see', which goes in <Serif ct="see"> (italic serif swap).
Inline serif-italic span inside l2, animated on its own (blur). Same fg color, no accent.
Thin accent text caret (≈6×96px bar) just after 'motion.'. The only accent in the frame.

scenes.motion: Background `solid`: near-black, no glow (the world before eyes). b1: l1 `maskUp` split words (hero ease, `word` stagger). The caret `fade`s in as l1 lands and `m.blink`s until b2, then fades. b2: l2 `maskUp` split words. b3: `m.tween('see', { blur: [0, 8], opacity: [1, 0.45] }, slow, standard)`, so the word stays soft into the dip. Camera `m.camera({ scale: [1, 1.04] })` over the whole scene. Nothing exits; the dip is the exit.

scenes.intent: The turn: Continuity gives agents a studio process, and eyes.

beats.note: eyebrow + headline reveal
pipeline rail draws, step pills pop as it passes
'Plan' lights up accent; the process starts

text.headline: Give agents a studio. And eyes.

elements.note: Mono uppercase tracked eyebrow, muted, left edge.
h1 (120px), two lines broken by meaning: 'Give agents a studio.' / 'And eyes.'. 'eyes' in <Serif ct="eyes"> (it answers the hook's 'see').
Inline serif-italic span inside the headline. No separate motion.
Hairline horizontal <Path> (2px, border color) across the safe width. The pills sit on it, evenly spaced (0/25/50/75/100%).
<Pill> 'Plan', no dot at first. Holds a stacked accent dot `plan-dot` (opacity 0) for b3.
<Pill> 'Check'.
<Pill> 'Measure'.
<Pill> 'Critique'.
<Pill> 'Ship'. The destination, at the right end of the rail.
<Glow color="accent"> low opacity, top right, behind the headline's end.

scenes.motion: Background `aurora` (light arrives). b1: eyebrow `fadeBlur`; headline `maskUp` split lines at b1+0.12. b2: rail `draw` left→right (hero, inOut). The five pills `scalePop` in reading order with a 0.14s stagger so each pops as the line reaches it (all landed by ≈2.9s). b3: `plan-dot` `scalePop` + `plan` `pulse`: chapter 01 starts and the push carries us into it. Ambient: `m.loop('glow', { scale: 0.04 }, { period: 6 })`. Camera `{ scale: [1, 1.02], x: [0, -24] }`, a drift toward the push. Nothing exits.

scenes.intent: Plan before pixels: the director writes a storyboard of scenes, copy and timed beats before any code.

beats.note: eyebrow + headline, storyboard window rises
beat lanes wipe on, beat ticks land
the current scene row (plan) glows

text.headline: Plan before pixels.
text.sub: Scenes and beats, timed before code.

elements.note: Mono uppercase eyebrow with a small accent dot before it (echoes the 'Plan' pill).
h2 (88px), one line, left edge.
text-caption (30px), muted, one line, under the headline.
<Window title="storyboard.json"> ≈1600×600, left edge aligned with the copy. Body: two columns, `rows` left (≈55%) and `lanes` right.

<List> of 5 rows (rows-r0…r4): 'hook · the problem' 3.9s | 'studio · the turn' 4.4s | 'plan · storyboard' 4.8s (status accent) | 'check · eyes on frames' 6.6s | 'measure · motion chart' 5.0s. Other rows have no status.

5 beat lanes (lane0…lane4) aligned to the 78px row rhythm. Each is a hairline bar whose width is proportional to the scene's duration (59/67/73/100/76%), with accent beat ticks (tick0…tick11, about 2–3 per lane) at this storyboard's real beat times.

scenes.motion: Background `grid`. The push brings the storyboard window in (no own entrance). Eyebrow present at 0; headline `maskUp` lines at 0.2; sub `rise` at after:headline-0.25. Rows cascade from 0.5, lanes `wipeRight` from 0.9, beat markers `scalePop` from 1.2, all landed by b2. At b2+0.5 the current (plan) row highlights; only its markers are accent. Camera `{ scale: [1, 1.03] }`.

scenes.intent: Eyes on every frame: the contact sheet shows a defect, the gate names it, the fix turns it green.

beats.note: headline (surfaces arrive with the push); frames bloom from center at b1+0.3
`pnpm ct check launch` types
RED: 2 red findings + red ring on f5, other frames recede, camera focus push; red holds settled ≥ 1.4s
GREEN: bars separate, ring clears, findings struck through, dots go green, ✔ line, sheet restores

elements.note: Mono uppercase eyebrow with a small accent dot.
h2 (88px), one line, left edge.
<Card> ≈820×600: a contact sheet, a 3×3 grid of 16:9 thumbnails (≈240×135, 16px gaps). No readable text in the thumbnails, only shapes.
Thumbnails f0…f8: miniature frames of this film (dark tiles, 1–2 light type bars, a hairline UI box, an accent dot here and there). Vary them.
The defect frame (row 2, col 3). Its headline bar `f5b` overlaps the CTA bar `f5a`, a collision readable at thumbnail scale.
3px danger-red rounded outline around f5.
<Window title="zsh"> ≈820×600. Body stacks: `cmd`, `findings`, `done`.
<Terminal lines={['$ pnpm ct check launch']}>, line cmd-l0 is typed.
<List> 2 rows, status 'danger': r0 'overlap · headline × cta' meta 'f5'; r1 'contrast 3.1:1 · caption' meta 'f5'. Overlay positive dots `good0` / `good1` exactly on the red status dots (opacity 0).
<Terminal lines={['✔ 0 errors · 0 warnings']}>. Green via the kit's ✔ styling. Line done-l0.

scenes.motion: Background `grid`. The push brings both surfaces in. Eyebrow at 0; headline `maskUp` at 0.2; frames bloom from centre at 0.5; b2: command types. b3: two red findings + red ring (4px, glow) on f5, other frames dim; red holds settled ≥ 1.4s. b4: the fix — f5 bars separate, ring fades, findings struck through + muted, dots go green, ✔ line rises; frames return. Camera 1→1.012 ambient, then a focus push to 1.033 at b3 (max that keeps the 1728px layout action-safe).

scenes.intent: Motion, measured: rhythm, easing and dead air are numbers the agent checks, not vibes.

energy curve wipes on under the playhead
three green verdict pills pop as the playhead lands

elements.note: Mono uppercase eyebrow with a small accent dot.
h2 (88px), one line, left edge.
text-caption (30px), muted.
<Window title="ct motion · launch.mp4"> ≈1600×600. Body: `energy` on top, the pill row underneath.
<LineChart> ≈1440×300, data [0.15, 0.7, 0.35, 0.85, 0.3, 0.65, 0.95, 0.4, 0.8, 0.3, 0.75, 0.9]: peaks on beats, valleys on holds, never flat (no dead zones). Parts energy-line, energy-area.

scenes.motion: Background `grid`. The push brings the chart window in. Eyebrow at 0; headline `maskUp` at 0.2; sub after:headline-0.25. b2: the chart (this film's own motion energy, smoothed, 7 scene labels on the baseline) wipes on left→right under a locked playhead; b3: three green verdict pills pop as the playhead arrives. scenes.intent: A critic scores every cut on five axes, and only the best version ships.

beats.note: headline in; scorecard already on screen (came with the push)
axis fills grow and scores count
verdict: 'best of 3 · ships'

elements.note: Mono uppercase eyebrow with a small accent dot.
h2 (88px), one line, left edge.
text-caption (30px), muted.
<Card> ≈1600×600, two columns: `axes` left (≈65%), `mean` + `ships` right, separated by a hairline.

5 rows ax0…ax4: label (sans 28px) 'Intent' 'Composition' 'Typography' 'Temporal' 'Craft'; <Progress ct=bar0…bar4 width≈560> values 0.92/0.88/0.96/0.90/0.94; mono value counters v0…v4 → 4.6 / 4.4 / 4.8 / 4.5 / 4.7.
<Stat value={4.6} decimals={1} label="v3 · mean score">.
<Pill dot="positive">best of 3 · ships</Pill> under the stat.
<Sheen> inside the card (card needs overflow-hidden).

scenes.motion: Background `grid`. The push brings the scorecard in with labels, empty tracks and 0.0 counters. Eyebrow at 0; headline at 0.2; fills + counters 0.6–1.8 (stagger 0.08); mean counts 0.8–2.2 then pulses; b3: `ships` pops (CTA sizing); a soft sheen (0.06) sweeps 3.2–4.1, leaving ≥ 0.5s of stillness before the dip. Camera `{ scale: [1, 1.025] }`.

scenes.intent: Brand, promise, CTA: Continuity. Motion design, as code. Open source.

beats.note: wordmark tracks in
tagline rises
'Open source' CTA pops; hold ≥ 2s

elements.note: Display (168px) Inter Tight semibold, centered. The film's only centered frame.
text-lead (48px), muted, centered under the wordmark.
<Pill dot="accent">Open source</Pill>, centered.
<Glow color="accent"> soft, behind the wordmark.

scenes.motion: Background `aurora`. b1: wordmark `trackIn` (hero); glow `fade` (slow) with it, then `m.loop('glow', { scale: 0.04 }, { period: 6 })`. b2: tagline `rise` 24px (slow). b3: cta `scalePop` (snappy). Then hold, settled, for more than 2s. Camera `{ scale: [1, 1.03] }` (gentle). Last scene: no transition, the film ends on the held card.
